title: Elijah calls down fire against the priests of Baal

tellings.quote: the Bible who did something similar calling down lightning. He had a battle of the against the priests of Bal to see whether our god or their god would uh light this sacrificial fire.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, retold a Bible story on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026. He says the prophet Elijah held a contest against the priests of Baal to see whose god would light a sacrificial fire, and that Elijah called down lightning to do it. He tells it as an ancient example of the kind of power over nature he discusses.
